mapper.sql: r.id, r.topic_id, r.activity_id, r.chapter_id, r.offer_id, r.supplier_kind, r.merchant_id, r.payer_kind, r.payer_id, r.basis, r.quantity, r.unit_amount, r.amount, r.status, r.settled_at, r.settled_by, r.voucher_no, r.note, r.registration_id, r.redemption_id, r.idempotency_key, r.create_time, r.update_time
, coalesce(a.name, t.name) as activity_title, c.name as chapter_name, coalesce(mm.name, m.nickname) as merchant_name

left join cms_activity a on a.id = r.activity_id left join cms_topic t on t.id = r.topic_id left join cms_topic_chapter c on c.id = r.chapter_id left join ums_member m on m.id = r.merchant_id left join mms_merchant mm on mm.id = (select max(m3.id) from mms_merchant m3 where m3.member_id = r.merchant_id and m3.del_flag = 0)

left join club pc on r.payer_kind = 'CLUB' and pc.id = r.payer_id and pc.del_flag = 0 left join club_personal_payout_beneficiary pb on r.payer_kind = 'CLUB' and ((r.activity_id is not null and pb.scope_type = 'ACTIVITY' and pb.scope_id = r.activity_id) or (r.activity_id is null and pb.scope_type = 'TOPIC' and pb.scope_id = r.topic_id))

((r.payer_kind = 'MEMBER' and r.payer_id = #{memberId}) or (r.payer_kind = 'CLUB' and ((pb.member_id is not null and pb.member_id = #{memberId}) or (pb.member_id is null and pc.member_id = #{memberId}))))
mapper.insert: insert into fe_reference_settlement (topic_id, activity_id, chapter_id, offer_id, supplier_kind, merchant_id, payer_kind, payer_id, basis, quantity, unit_amount, amount, status, settled_at, settled_by, voucher_no, note, registration_id, redemption_id, idempotency_key, create_time) values (#{topicId}, #{activityId}, #{chapterId}, #{offerId}, #{supplierKind}, #{merchantId}, #{payerKind}, #{payerId}, #{basis}, #{quantity}, #{unitAmount}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{settledAt}, #{settledBy}, #{voucherNo}, #{note}, #{registrationId}, #{redemptionId}, #{idempotencyKey}, now())
mapper.select: select from fe_reference_settlement r where r.idempotency_key = #{key}
mapper.update: update fe_reference_settlement f set f.status = 'VOID', f.update_time = now() where f.registration_id = #{registrationId} and f.status = 'OPEN' and (f.redemption_id is null or not exists (select 1 from redemption d where d.id = f.redemption_id and d.status = 'ACTIVE'))
mapper.select:
select from fe_reference_settlement r
where and r.status != 'VOID' and r.activity_id = #{activityId} order by r.activity_id desc, r.id desc
select from fe_reference_settlement r where and r.id in #{id} order by r.id for update
mapper.update: update fe_reference_settlement set status = 'SETTLED_OFFLINE', settled_at = now(), settled_by = #{memberId}, voucher_no = #{voucherNo}, note = coalesce(#{note}, note), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status in ('OPEN', 'DISPUTED')

update fe_reference_settlement set status = 'DISPUTED', note = #{note}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and supplier_kind = 'MERCHANT' and status in ('OPEN', 'SETTLED_OFFLINE')
